body.name: Endpoint confidence-region inversion
body.construction: If \(\mathcal C_N\neq\varnothing\), set \(I_N=[\min_{(o',e')\in\mathcal C_N}L(o',e'),\max_{(o',e')\in\mathcal C_N}U(o',e')]\); otherwise set \(I_N=[0,1]\). Represent the lower optimization with one epigraph variable and the upper optimization with variables \(z_j\geq0\), \(z_j\geq t-c_j\), and \(\sum_jz_j\leq t\).
